content: Anthropic consumer terms (clarified Feb 2026) prohibit Free/Pro/Max OAuth tokens in third-party tools; enforcement and billing policy changed repeatedly in 2026 (server-side checks Jan, third-party draw from extra usage Apr, credit plan announced May then paused Jun). CLIProxyAPI users report Google/Antigravity account bans (#1637, #1631), Antigravity 429 triggered by system-prompt identity text (#4696), Codex token invalidation waves (#3654), and Codex refresh tokens are single-use (refresh_token_reused reports). GitHub flags scripted/multi-account Copilot use via abuse detection. OmniRoute had false permanent bans from single 403s (#12859, #13157) and wedged refresh mutex on hung fetch (#14970).
